label: Signed outcome service
summary: Turn an offchain result into a bounded, domain-separated and replay-safe onchain claim.
requiredFacts: Canonical signed payload, domain, chain, contract, nonce and expiry
Signer authority, rotation, revocation, compromise and quorum policy
Outcome finality, challenge, cancellation and dispute behavior
requiredFiles: Signer service source or attributable interface
requiredTests: Wrong domain, chain, contract, signer, nonce and expiry
Signer rotation, revocation and compromise containment
risks: A compromised signer can fabricate results
Weak domain separation enables cross-project replay
Offchain finality can conflict with onchain payout finality
